scanNote:
WORKBOOK 13-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (56-bet, PDF 54). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '13' va 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN:
11) 'Complete the survey below with verbs from the list in the correct form.' Qiya: 'read, learn, travel, enter, stay in, play, visit'. 'STILLWELL LEISURE CENTRE GENERAL SURVEY' (Yes/No katakchalar): 1 Do you enjoy ...... museums and galleries? 2 Do you mind ...... and watching TV? 3 Do you like ...... books? 4 Would you like ...... a foreign language? 5 Do you enjoy ...... sports? 6 Do you expect ...... abroad for your holidays this year? 7 Do you want ...... our free draw for a 2-week holiday in Paris? 'We thank you for completing the above survey. Please leave your completed forms at the reception desk in the Stillwell Leisure Centre.'
12) 'Complete the dialogues by forming questions using the prompts.' A Bob: What 1) ...... (you/enjoy/do/free time)? Ann: Well, I love going to parties. Bob: Do you 2) ...... (like/dance)? Ann: Yes, I do! Bob: What 3) ...... (you/hate/do)? Ann: Well, I hate listening to boring music! B Beth: Did 1) ...... (you/remember/collect/tickets/concert/tonight)? Alan: Yes, but we've got an extra one because Kenny can't come. 2) ...... (would/your brother/like/come)? Beth: I'm sure he would. Alan: 3) ...... (he/like/listen to/classical music)? Beth: Oh, yes! He's got lots of classical CDs.

O'NG USTUN:
• 'Communication: Giving Directions'.
13a) 'Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words.' Qiya: 'right, take, reach, go past'. Colin: So, where are you having your 18th birthday party? At home? Jane: No, at Zippy's. Colin: Where? Jane: Zippy's. It's a new nightclub in town. Colin: How do I get there from my house? Jane: Okay, you turn right outside your house and then turn left down London Road. You 1) ...... the first turning on your left, then 2) ...... the butcher's, the chemist's and the cinema, and turn right down Potters Lane. When you 3) ...... Fenton Street, turn left. Zippy's is on your 4) ......, between the hairdresser's and the newsagent's. Colin: Right, that sounds simple enough. What time should I come? Jane: About nine o'clock. Colin: Great. I'll see you there!
  XARITA: Oak Street (yuqori), Green Street (o'rta), Gabriel Street (past); London Road (o'ng, vertikal); Potters Lane (o'rta, vertikal); Fenton Street (chap, Potters Lane'dan chapga). Green Street bo'yida: Cinema, Chemist's, Butcher's (chapdan o'ngga). Fenton Street/Potters Lane burchagida: Newsagent's, Zippy's, Hairdresser's (diagonal). Mary's House - yuqori o'ngda (Oak Street); Colin's House - pastda (Gabriel Street).
13b) 'Use the prompts below to give directions to Mary about how to get to Zippy's from her house.' '... turn left/right (down) ... take the 1st/2nd/3rd turning on your ... when you reach ... ... on your left/right/your ... between ...'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '56'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the survey below with verbs from the list in the correct form: read, learn, travel, enter, stay in, play, visit. (Stillwell Leisure Centre General Survey)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'rovnomani ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring: read, learn, travel, enter, stay in, play, visit. (Stillwell dam olish markazi umumiy so'rovnomasi)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROVNOMA - INFINITIV / -ING.

  enjoy + V-ING: enjoy visiting,
    enjoy playing
  mind + V-ING: mind staying in
  like + V-ING: like reading
  would like + TO: would like to
    learn
  expect + TO: expect to travel
  want + TO: want to enter


⚠ 'DO YOU MIND + V-ING?':

  = ... ga qarshi emasmisiz?


⚠ 'TO ENTER A DRAW':

  = lotereyada qatnashmoq.
  'a free draw' = bepul lotereya.


⚠ 'A LEISURE CENTRE':

  = dam olish markazi.


⚠ 'ABROAD':

  = chet elga (predlogsiz!).

Do you mind ___ and watching TV?
items.uz: Uyda qolib televizor ko'rishga qarshi emasmisiz?

items.sentence: Would you like ___ a foreign language?
Do you expect ___ abroad for your holidays this year?
items.uz: Bu yil ta'tilga chet elga sayohat qilishni kutyapsizmi?

items.sentence: Do you want ___ our free draw for a 2-week holiday in Paris?
items.uz: Parijda 2 haftalik ta'til uchun bepul lotereyamizda qatnashishni xohlaysizmi?

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues by forming questions using the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan savollar tuzib dialoglarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TUZISh - INFINITIV / -ING.

  A:
  1 What do you enjoy DOING in
    your free time?
  2 Do you like DANCING?
  3 What do you hate DOING?
  B:
  1 Did you remember TO COLLECT the
    tickets for the concert
    tonight?
  2 Would your brother like TO
    COME?
  3 Does he like LISTENING TO
    classical music?


⚠ 'AN EXTRA ONE':

  = qo'shimcha bitta (chipta).


⚠ 'TO COLLECT TICKETS':

  = chiptalarni olib kelmoq.

lines.answer: do you enjoy doing in your free time

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words: right, take, reach, go past.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying: right, take, reach, go past.
exercises.explanationUz:
YO'L KO'RSATISh (coursebook 96-bet
  muloqot).

  turn right/left = o'ngga/chapga
    buriling
  turn left DOWN London Road = ...
    ko'chasi bo'ylab chapga
  TAKE the first turning on your
    left = birinchi burilishda
    chapga
  GO PAST the butcher's = qassob
    do'koni yonidan o'ting
  when you REACH Fenton Street =
    ... ga yetganingizda
  on your RIGHT = o'ng tomoningizda
  between X and Y = ... orasida


⚠ 'HOW DO I GET THERE?':

  = U yerga qanday boraman?


⚠ 'THAT SOUNDS SIMPLE ENOUGH':

  = ancha oson ko'rinadi.


⚠ KOLINNING YO'LI (xarita):

  Gabriel Street → o'ngga → London
  Road bo'ylab chapga (yuqoriga) →
  Green Street (1-burilish chapga)
  → butcher's, chemist's, cinema
  yonidan → Potters Lane bo'ylab
  o'ngga → Fenton Street'da chapga
  → Zippy's o'ngda.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: So, where are you having your 18th birthday party? At home?
lines.uz: Xo'sh, 18 yoshlik tug'ilgan kuningni qayerda nishonlaysan? Uydami?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: No, at Zippy's.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: Where?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: Zippy's. It's a new nightclub in town.
lines.uz: Zippy's. Bu shahardagi yangi tungi klub.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: How do I get there from my house?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: Okay, you turn right outside your house and then turn left down London Road. You 1) ___ the first turning on your left,
lines.uz: Xo'p, uyingdan chiqib o'ngga burilasan, keyin London Road bo'ylab chapga. Birinchi burilishda chapga o'tasan,
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'take the first turning' = birinchi burilishda o'tmoq.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: then 2) ___ the butcher's, the chemist's and the cinema, and turn right down Potters Lane.
lines.uz: keyin qassob do'koni, dorixona va kinoteatr yonidan o'tib, Potters Lane bo'ylab o'ngga burilasan.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: When you 3) ___ Fenton Street, turn left.

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: Zippy's is on your 4) ___, between the hairdresser's and the newsagent's.
lines.uz: Zippy's o'ng tomoningda, sartaroshxona va gazeta do'koni orasida.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Xaritada: Fenton Street'da chapga burilgach Zippy's O'NGDA.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: Right, that sounds simple enough. What time should I come?
lines.uz: Xo'p, ancha oson ko'rinadi. Soat nechada kelay?

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.en: About nine o'clock.

lines.speaker: Colin
lines.en: Great. I'll see you there!

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to give directions to Mary about how to get to Zippy's from her house: ... turn left/right (down) ... take the 1st/2nd/3rd turning on your ... when you reach ... ... on your left/right/your ... between ... (Map: Mary's house is at the top right on Oak Street; Zippy's is at the corner of Potters Lane and Fenton Street, between the newsagent's and the hairdresser's.)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan Meriga uyidan Zippy's ga qanday borishni tushuntiring: ... turn left/right (down) ... take the 1st/2nd/3rd turning on your ... when you reach ... ... on your left/right/your ... between ... (Xarita: Merining uyi yuqori o'ngda, Oak Street'da; Zippy's - Potters Lane va Fenton Street burchagida, gazeta do'koni va sartaroshxona orasida.)
exercises.explanationUz:
MERINING YO'LI (xarita):

  Merining uyi - Oak Street, yuqori
  o'ng. Zippy's - Potters Lane va
  Fenton Street burchagi (chap).

  1 Uydan chiqib CHAPGA (Oak Street
    bo'ylab g'arbga)
  2 Potters Lane'ga yetganda CHAPGA
    (pastga)
  3 Birinchi burilish O'NGDA -
    Fenton Street
  4 Zippy's O'NG tomonda, newsagent's
    va hairdresser's orasida.


⚠ 'TURNING':

  = burilish (ko'cha).
